description:
We are seeking permission for the removal of five Pedunculate Oaks situated within our
staff compound. This request is in preparation for the upcoming demolition and
subsequent reconstruction of the compound. (While I previously submitted a
separate application for these trees, I was advised to include the tree removal
request within the staff compound reconstruction application. However, our
contractor has requested that the removal be done prior to their involvement.)
These particular trees hold limited amenity value in relation to the Golf Course,
largely due to their placement within a stand of Oaks and Beech trees forming the
perimeter of the staff compound. Consequently, their visual impact on the Golf
Course and the entire conservation area is minimal.
The existing trees pose an obstruction to the proposed construction process,
which demands an unobstructed and clear site. The removal of these trees is
crucial to facilitate the smooth execution of the reconstruction project while
ensuring the safety of all parties involved.
We fully acknowledge the significance of trees and remain dedicated to
mitigating the ecological consequences of their removal. We acknowledge 
that we put this in and had this accepted on 29th august 2023 but never proceeded with the works.
